fragment.choose:
<when condition="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("aforo-preflight-enabled", "false") == "true" && context.Request.Method != "OPTIONS" && Convert.ToString(context.Variables["aforo-preflight-customer"]).Length > 0 && context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("aforo-preflight-url", "").Trim().Length > 0)">
            
            
            
            
            <set-variable name="aforo-preflight-call" value="@{
                var c = context.Variables.ContainsKey("aforo-preflight-cached") ? Convert.ToString(context.Variables["aforo-preflight-cached"]) : "";
                if (c == null || c.Length == 0) { return "true"; }
                if (!c.StartsWith("F:", StringComparison.Ordinal)) { return "false"; }
                if (!System.Text.RegularExpressions.Regex.IsMatch(c, "^F:[0-9]{1,5}$")) { return "true"; }
                var lim = Convert.ToString(context.Variables["aforo-preflight-limits"]).Split(',');
                return Convert.ToInt32(c.Substring(2)) < Convert.ToInt32(lim[1]) ? "true" : "false";
            }" />
            
                
                    
                        @(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("aforo-preflight-url", "").Trim())
                        POST
                        
                            application/json
                        
                        
                            @(context.Variables.ContainsKey("aforo-api-key") ? Convert.ToString(context.Variables["aforo-api-key"]) : "{{aforo-api-key}}")
                        
                        @{
                            var body = new JObject();
                            body["customerId"] = Convert.ToString(context.Variables["aforo-preflight-customer"]);
                            return body.ToString(Newtonsoft.Json.Formatting.None);
                        }
                    
                
            
            <set-variable name="aforo-preflight-answer" value="@{
                if (Convert.ToString(context.Variables["aforo-preflight-call"]) != "true") { return ""; }
                try {
                    var response = context.Variables.ContainsKey("preflightResponse") ? (IResponse)context.Variables["preflightResponse"] : null;
                    if (response == null || response.StatusCode != 200) { return "UNAVAILABLE"; }
                    var body = response.Body.As();
                    /* The ingestor wraps every 2xx as success + data + meta. */
                    var data = body["data"] ?? body;
                    var decision = (data["decision"]?.ToString() ?? "ALLOW").Trim().ToUpperInvariant();
                    if (decision != "DENY") { return decision == "WARN" ? "WARN" : "ALLOW"; }
                    var raw = data["retryAfterMs"];
                    long ms = raw != null && raw.Type == JTokenType.Integer ? (long)raw : 5000;
                    var seconds = (ms + 999) / 1000;
                    if (seconds < 1) { seconds = 1; }
                    if (seconds > 60) { seconds = 60; }
                    return "DENY|" + seconds;
                } catch {
                    return "UNAVAILABLE";
                }
            }" />
            
            
                
                    
                
            
            <set-variable name="preflightDecision" value="@{
                var fallback = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("aforo-preflight-fallback", "ALLOW").Trim().ToUpperInvariant() == "DENY" ? "DENY" : "ALLOW";
                var a = Convert.ToString(context.Variables["aforo-preflight-answer"]);
                if (Convert.ToString(context.Variables["aforo-preflight-call"]) == "true") {
                    if (a == "ALLOW" || a == "WARN") { return a; }
                    return a.StartsWith("DENY|", StringComparison.Ordinal) ? "DENY" : fallback;
                }
                var c = context.Variables.ContainsKey("aforo-preflight-cached") ? Convert.ToString(context.Variables["aforo-preflight-cached"]) : "";
                if (c == null) { c = ""; }
                if (c.StartsWith("D:DENY:", StringComparison.Ordinal)) { return "DENY"; }
                if (c == "D:WARN") { return "WARN"; }
                if (c == "D:ALLOW") { return "ALLOW"; }
                return fallback;
            }" />
            <set-variable name="aforo-preflight-retry-after" value="@{
                var a = Convert.ToString(context.Variables["aforo-preflight-answer"]);
                if (a != null && a.StartsWith("DENY|", StringComparison.Ordinal)) { return a.Substring(5); }
                var c = context.Variables.ContainsKey("aforo-preflight-cached") ? Convert.ToString(context.Variables["aforo-preflight-cached"]) : "";
                if (c != null && System.Text.RegularExpressions.Regex.IsMatch(c, "^D:DENY:[0-9]{1,12}$")) {
                    var left = Convert.ToInt64(c.Substring(7)) - Convert.ToInt64(Convert.ToString(context.Variables["aforo-preflight-now"]));
                    return left < 1 ? "1" : left.ToString();
                }
                return "60";
            }" />
            
                <when condition="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("preflightDecision") == "DENY")">
                    
                        
                        
                            application/json
                        
                        
                            @(Convert.ToString(context.Variables["aforo-preflight-retry-after"]))
                        
                        {"message": "Rate limit exceeded"}
                    
                
                <when condition="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("preflightDecision") == "WARN")">
                    
                        approaching-limit
